About Radiator Buy

Radiator Buy is a UK-based online retailer specializing in high-quality designer radiators, vertical radiators, bathroom radiators, heated towel rails, and home heating solutions. We offer stylish, energy-efficient products that combine performance, reliability, and modern design.

What makes us different

• Premium quality products with competitive pricing
• Free mainland UK delivery on eligible orders
• 25-year warranty on selected products
• Dedicated customer support and expert advice
• Strong conversion potential in the home improvement and interior design market

How affiliates can earn

Affiliates earn 8% commission on every successful referral order. Customers referred through your affiliate link or coupon code receive 10% OFF each of their orders, making it easier to convert visitors into customers.

Commission details

• 8% commission per successful sale
• 30-day cookie duration
• Manual application review
• Commissions are held for 60 days to allow for returns, refunds, and chargebacks
• Approved commissions are paid monthly via PayPal

How to promote us

Our program is ideal for:

• Interior designers
• Home improvement bloggers
• Property developers
• Heating installers
• Architects
• Influencers in home and lifestyle niches

Affiliates can promote Radiator Buy through websites, blogs, social media channels, email newsletters, and other approved marketing methods.

We look forward to building long-term partnerships with affiliates who share our passion for quality home heating products.

Radiator Buy Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Radiator Buy Affiliate Program.

Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program. By registering as an affiliate, you agree to comply with the following Terms and Conditions.

1. Enrollment

Radiator Buy reserves the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at its sole discretion.

Affiliates must provide accurate and complete information during registration. Any false, misleading, or incomplete information may result in the rejection or termination of an affiliate account.

2. Affiliate Links and Promotion

Upon approval, affiliates will receive a unique referral link and may be assigned a coupon code.

Affiliates may promote Radiator Buy through websites, blogs, social media platforms, email newsletters, online communities, and other legitimate marketing channels.

Affiliates must not:

Use misleading or deceptive advertising.

Impersonate Radiator Buy.

Bid on Radiator Buy branded keywords in paid advertising campaigns without written permission.

Publish false claims regarding Radiator Buy products or services.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recently clicked affiliate link will receive the referral credit.

If a customer uses both an affiliate link and an affiliate coupon code, only one commission will be awarded for the order. Commissions are not duplicated.

3. Commission Structure

Affiliates earn 8% commission on eligible referral sales.

Commission is calculated based on the order subtotal only and excludes:

VAT and other taxes

Shipping charges

Shipping taxes

Tips or additional service fees

Commission rates may be updated by Radiator Buy at any time with reasonable notice.

4. Customer Discount

New customers referred by affiliates may receive 10% OFF their first order, subject to current promotional eligibility and merchant settings.

Radiator Buy reserves the right to modify or discontinue promotional offers at any time.

5. Cookie Duration

Radiator Buy uses a 30-day tracking cookie.

If a customer clicks an affiliate referral link, any eligible purchase completed within 30 days may generate commission for the referring affiliate.

If cookies are disabled, blocked, or deleted, referral tracking may not function correctly and commissions may not be recorded.

6. Commission Approval Period

All commissions are subject to a 60-day holding period from the order date.

Commissions will only be approved if the order is not:

Cancelled

Refunded

Returned

Subject to a chargeback

Identified as fraudulent

Radiator Buy reserves the right to review all referral orders before approving commissions.

7. Payment Schedule

Approved commissions are paid on the first working day of each month.

Only commissions that have successfully completed the 60-day approval period are eligible for payment.

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information.

Radiator Buy is not responsible for delays caused by incomplete or incorrect payment details.

8. Self-Referrals

Affiliates are not permitted to earn commissions on purchases made for their own personal use.

Any self-referrals or attempts to abuse the affiliate program may result in commission cancellation and account termination.

9. Fraudulent Activity

Radiator Buy reserves the right to withhold commissions and terminate affiliate accounts involved in:

Fraudulent transactions

Fake referrals

Spam marketing

Misleading advertising

Abuse of coupons or referral links

Any activity deemed harmful to Radiator Buy

10. Program Modification or Termination

Radiator Buy reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the Affiliate Program at any time.

Changes may include commission rates, cookie duration, promotional offers, payment schedules, or other program rules.

Continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of any updated terms.

Affiliates may leave the program at any time by contacting info@radiatorbuy.com. Any unpaid commissions that do not meet the program requirements may be forfeited.

11. Contact Information

If you have any questions regarding the Affiliate Program, please contact us at:

info@radiatorbuy.com

You may also contact us through the live chat available on our website and we will respond as soon as possible.

Thank you for partnering with Radiator Buy.
